newDialog.title: New symptom

newDialog.codeHint: Capital letters, digits and underscores: BELT_SLIPS.
newDialog.forHint: A type's stations offer its own symptoms and those for every machine.

unsafeOff.body: A report of {code} will no longer mark the machine do-not-use at once: it only reaches maintenance, and the machine stays as it is.
unsafeOff.still: Anyone at the station can still mark a machine unsafe on the report itself; only a technician signs it safe again.

page.changedBody: Another person changed the routing, the lock or the check types since you opened them.

keys.new: New, in the card that has the focus (on the page: a new symptom)
keys.open: Open the rule or check type

section.noSiteBody: The routing and the lock are set per site, and this company has no site you may see.

notice.ruleGone: That routing rule is no longer at this site.
notice.typeGone: That check type is no longer in the list.

routing.title: Request routing and escalation
routing.purpose: Who gets a machine request, and when it escalates when nobody acknowledges it. A request follows the first rule that is on and fits its machine type.
routing.readOnly: You can view, not change: the routing is kept by a role that keeps the plant settings of this site (plant.settings.manage).
routing.emptyBody: Without a rule every request waits in the triage queue. Add one per machine type, and one for every machine type last.
routing.emptyBodyView: Without a rule every request waits in the triage queue.
routing.usedHint: Requests it routed: a rule used by any is switched off, never deleted, so they keep where they went.
routing.removeDeleted_one: {count} rule no request names is deleted.
routing.removeDeleted_other: {count} rules no request names are deleted.
routing.removeSwitched_one: {count} rule requests name is switched off and kept.
routing.removeSwitched_other: {count} rules requests name are switched off and kept.
routing.removeOffAlready_one: {count} rule is switched off already and stays as it is.
routing.removeOffAlready_other: {count} rules are switched off already and stay as they are.
routing.removeWhy: A rule a request names stays, so each request keeps where it went and who it escalated to.

preview.title: Where does a request go?
preview.hint: Pick a machine type to read where its request goes now, with the rules as saved.

example.off: This rule is switched off: requests skip it until it is on again.
example.noneAny: A request for any machine at {site} fits no rule: it waits in the triage queue.
example.noneClass: A request for a {class} at {site} fits no rule: it waits in the triage queue.

goesAny.team: A request for any machine at {site} goes to the team {target}.
goesAny.person: A request for any machine at {site} goes to {target}.

goesClass.team: A request for a {class} at {site} goes to the team {target}.
goesClass.person: A request for a {class} at {site} goes to {target}.

push.team: Each member of the team gets a notice at once.
push.person: They get a notice at once.

quiet.team: No notice: the team finds it in the queue.
quiet.person: No notice: they find it in the queue.

example.escalate: Not acknowledged in {minutes} min: {person} is told.
example.again: Still not acknowledged after {minutes} min: {person} is told.
example.noEscalation: It never escalates: it waits until someone acknowledges it.

rule.intro: A request follows the first rule that is on and fits its machine type; keep the rule for every machine type last. A request keeps the rule it followed, so a change here never rewrites it.
rule.forHint: Every machine type: the rule for what no other rule takes.
rule.teamHint: A team of this site: each member gets it.
rule.pickersForbidden: Choosing a team or a person needs the right to see people (people.view): the rule keeps the one it names.
rule.pushHintTeam: Each member of the team gets it in their bell.
rule.pushHintPerson: The technician gets it in their bell.
rule.escalateHint: A request still new and not acknowledged is told to a person.
rule.againHint: Later than the first, to another person.
rule.activeHint: Off: requests skip this rule and follow the next one that fits.
rule.removeDelete: No request names this rule: it is deleted.
rule.removeSwitchOff_one: {count} request names this rule: it is switched off and kept.
rule.removeSwitchOff_other: {count} requests name this rule: it is switched off and kept.

lock.title: Unsafe lock
lock.purpose: Who may lock a machine as unsafe, and who signs it safe again.
lock.lawPlain: Work equipment must be safe: a machine that is not safe is not used until it is checked and put right.
lock.defaults: Nothing saved for this site yet: these are the defaults (Owner answer H1).
lock.readOnly: You can view, not change: the lock is kept by a role that keeps the plant settings of this site (plant.settings.manage).
lock.lockBy: Who may lock a machine as unsafe

by.ANYONE_AT_STATIONHint: The default: whoever sees the danger locks the machine at once from the tablet or the office.

sign.TECHNICIANSHint: Only a technician who checked it signs the machine safe; the office asks a fresh code.
sign.TECHNICIANS_AND_SAFETY_OFFICER: A technician or the safety officer

lock.heldByH1: Held by Owner answer H1: not offered until the Owner decides.
lock.h1Body: Anyone at the station locks an unsafe machine at once, and only a technician signs it safe again. The other choices wait for the Owner's word.
lock.hazard: A lock asks for a hazard report
lock.hazardHint: Each lock opens a hazard report in the plant’s Incidents, naming the machine and the request.
lock.looserBody: Without the hazard report a lock leaves no record in Incidents. Nexus asks your authenticator code when you apply.

checks.title: Statutory check types
checks.purpose: Each check type with its legal basis, default interval, outside body and how long its results are kept. The whole group's list.
checks.retentionPlain: The results of the checks are kept at least {years} years.
checks.readOnly: You can view, not change: the check types are the whole group's, kept with plant.checks.manage over every company.
checks.emptyBody: Add the checks the law asks of your machines, each with its legal basis: plans in Preventive & statutory checks use them.
checks.emptyBodyView: Nobody has added a check type yet.
checks.lawPlain: The law or standard this check rests on, as typed in Plant settings.
checks.keptHint: The type keeps its results {years} years; never fewer than the law's.

keys.new: New check type (focus in this card)

checks.retireBody: A retired type takes no new plan. The plans that use it now ({plans}) keep their dates and their results.
checks.restoreBody: New plans may use it again.

checkType.intro: The code and the machine type never change once added (plans and results keep them). The legal basis is in your words: Nexus knows no interval of a law.
checkType.retiredNote: Retired: it takes no new plan.
checkType.inUse: Used by {plans} active plans and {results} results.
checkType.codeHint: Capital letters, digits and underscores: PRESS_GUARDS.
checkType.classHint: Any machine, or one machine type.
checkType.lawHint: The law or standard the check rests on, in words, as the inspector will read it.
checkType.intervalHint: A plan starts with it and may change it; at most {max} in this unit.
checkType.outsideHint: An inspection body or a notified body does the check; plans name which one.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.purpose: The kinds of report and the INAIL rule, shown with their law.
incidents.noRight: You can't see the incident rules
incidents.noRightBody: They need the right to see incidents (safety.incidents.view).
incidents.lawSays: What the law asks of an injury with days off work.
incidents.statisticalValue_one: From {count} day of absence beyond the day of the event
incidents.statisticalValue_other: From {count} days of absence beyond the day of the event
incidents.windowValue_one: Within {count} hour of receiving the medical certificate
incidents.windowValue_other: Within {count} hours of receiving the medical certificate
incidents.fixed: The law sets these: they are not changed here, and Nexus follows the law as it stands.
incidents.remindersValue: {hours} hours before, and at the deadline
incidents.remindersHint: Nexus's own reminders, not the law's: to those who file the reports at the site.
incidents.anonymous: May be sent from a tablet without a name
incidents.anonymousHint: Never an injury: an injury always names the person hurt.
incidents.photosValue_one: Up to {count} photo, within {minutes} minutes of the report
incidents.photosValue_other: Up to {count} photos, within {minutes} minutes of the report
incidents.people: Injury details are protected data: every view of them is recorded.
incidents.peoplePlain: Health data are a special category of personal data: only those who need them see them, and each view is recorded.

history.title: Plant settings: audit log
history.intro: Every change of the routing, the unsafe lock, the check types and the symptoms, newest first.
history.noRight: The audit log needs the right to read it (audit.read).

action.ruleUnchanged: Routing rule saved without a change
action.orderRoutingRules: Order of the routing rules changed
action.orderRoutingRulesCode: Order of the routing rules changed
action.lockUnchanged: Unsafe lock saved without a change
action.hazardOff: Hazard report on lock switched off
action.hazardOn: Hazard report on lock switched on

leave.title: Unsaved changes
leave.body: The Unsafe lock card has changes not saved. Save them, discard them, or stay on the page.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.lock: Switching the hazard report off loosens a safety rule: type the code of your authenticator app.

problem.wrong: That code is wrong or used already: type the new one.
problem.locked: Too many tries: wait a minute and try again.
problem.unavailable: The code could not be checked: try again.

refusal.H1_HELD: Owner answer H1 holds: anyone at the station locks an unsafe machine at once, and only a technician signs it safe again.
refusal.ORDER_INCOMPLETE: The rules changed while you moved them: the list was read again; move them once more.
refusal.TYPE_TAKEN: The group already has a check type with this code (it may be retired: make it active again instead).
refusal.TOO_MANY_TYPES: The group has the most check types it may keep: retire the ones no longer used first.
